name: BeVigil OSINT API (osint.bevigil.com)
tier_rationale: Identifiable security company (CloudSEK) with published API documentation and terms; council P007 cond 1 classes BeVigil community (A8).

reliability.justification: Hosts and URLs extracted from Android app (APK) assets that reference the domain: a distinct angle, but names may be stale or test endpoints.

bevigil.plan_hint: business = a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (never an analyst's personal free account, P007 cond 3); key_plans.bevigil='business' unlocks it under the corporate profile

subdomains.title: BeVigil subdomains and URLs from mobile-app assets (GET /api/{domain}/subdomains/ and /api/{domain}/urls/)

terms.quote: P007 cond 3 (binding council text): key-terms per adapter - a company/team account, never an analyst's personal free account, on a plan whose terms permit internal business use; legal records the plan and the terms URL in the registry before the adapter runs under the corporate profile (A1).

subdomains.notes: Research C0024 (verified_needs_key, 401 without key). Each endpoint call spends one monthly credit (numbers unpublished: the month figure of the quota block is an interim budget until legal records the team plan). URLs are in-apex pivots with expand=False (fetching them would be LIGHT); key-like query values are redacted. Used by subdomains_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-1 (P007, module subdomains_keyed).
